fields.summary: Attach screenshots and files when creating a task

content.text: Today attachments can only be added to a task that already exists: a user creates the task, opens it and then uploads files or pastes a screenshot. Users should be able to add attachments in the "New task" form itself, so that a task and its attachments are created in one step.
The form is the one opened from the "+" of a board column. Everything else in the form stays as it is.

The "New task" form has a section titled "Add attachments", collapsed when the form opens. Expanded, it shows a screenshot area with the text "Take a screenshot and press CTRL+V or ⌘+V to paste here." and a file area with the text "Drag and drop your files here or choose files".
Files picked through "choose files" or dropped on the file area are listed by name in the form before it is saved. Each listed file has a remove control; a file removed from the list is not attached.

Saving the form creates the task and stores every listed file as an attachment of the new task. The task's page lists them under "Attachments" with their original file names and sizes, and each can be downloaded with its content unchanged.

An image pasted while the form is open is previewed in the screenshot area. After saving, the new task has it as an attachment named "Screenshot taken" followed by the date and time, with the extension .png.

Attachments are optional. A task saved without any attachment is created as before: the message "Task created successfully." is shown, the task is on the board, and its "Attachments" section is empty.
The title is still required: saving the form without a title creates no task and reports "The title is required".

The existing fields of the form are not affected. A task created from the form, with or without attachments, keeps the assignee, column, priority, category and swimlane chosen in the form. This holds for a project that has categories and for a project with more than one swimlane as well as for a project that has neither.
With "Create another task" ticked, the task is created and the form opens again, empty, for the next task.
Limits on the size of attachments are those of the server configuration and are not part of this ticket. Attachments on existing tasks are unchanged.
